home.seoTitle: Luxury Durbar — Banquet, Events & Bratabandha in Kathmandu
home.seoDesc: Premium banquet hall in Kathmandu, Nepal for weddings, parties, birthday celebrations, and Bratabandha (bartabandha) ceremonies.
home.headline: Every celebration begins like a whisper and ends like a legend
home.subhead: Luxury Durbar is where Kathmandu gathers — for weddings that linger, nights that sparkle, and tables that never run out of stories.

about.seoDesc: Hospitality, detail, and coordination — the principles behind Luxury Durbar.
about.statement: We do not host parties. We stage lifetime stories — one table, one toast, one golden night at a time.
about.intro: Luxury Durbar was built as a destination for celebrations that deserve a grand stage — weddings that linger in memory, receptions that sparkle, and gatherings where every table holds good gossip.

hospitality.title: Hospitality
hospitality.text: Every guest is welcomed as family. Warm service is the foundation of an unforgettable night.

detail.title: Excellence in the Details
detail.text: A single light cue, a single course timing — outcomes are decided by the details, and we treat none of them as unimportant.

coordination.title: Seamless Coordination
coordination.text: From first inquiry to the final toast, a dedicated team keeps your celebration on time and on brand.
